raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) sends amount as a dollar-prefixed string such as '$75.13' instead of a plain '75.13', so the DECIMAL cast in silver_transactions fails. Currency is uniformly USD and the values otherwise look like normal amounts, so removing the leading '$' (and surrounding whitespace) gives the correct value. Thousands separators are deliberately not stripped, so any other unexpected format will still fail loudly rather than corrupt data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(regexp_replace(trim(amount), '^\\$\\s*', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
